newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy not as bad as bourse thinks--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy not as bad as bourse thinks--MOF.

text.p: Japan's economy is not in as bad as a state as the stock market thinks, a senior official at the Ministry of Finance (MOF) told Reuters on Thursday.
"Japan's economic fundamentals are not that bad. We have not seen bad factors as to warrant such a sharp fall in the Nikkei of more than 1,000 points over three days," the official said.
"I hope market participants will have more confidence," he added.
Tokyo stocks took another steep dive on Thursday, buckling under the weight of heavy losses in the banking sector as well as sporadic rounds of selling in futures contracts.
The Nikkei average of 225 leading shares closed down by 606.51 points or 3.25 percent at 18,073.87, their lowest close since November 1995.
